business_scope.primary_industry_name: Virtual Private Network and Digital Encryption Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (cross-strait investment-source jurisdiction); WFOE formation will occur in Mainland China

Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion (2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3 (2024), Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, effective November 1, 2024; Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (revised November 8, 2024, effective January 1, 2025); Law of the People's Republic of China on Protection of Investments by Taiwan Compatriots; Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective July 1, 2024); and the administrative provisions governing foreign-invested enterprise information reporting under the Regulations on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law of the PRC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign corporate investor and each material corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or companies registrar in the foreign investor's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille only if the issuing jurisdiction is a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; for non-member jurisdictions including Taiwan-origin documents, Consular Legalization by the competent PRC consular post or the applicable cross-strait notarization/verification authority only. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent certificate of active corporate status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or registrar of the foreign investor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille only if the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention Contracting State; otherwise Consular Legalization only. No sequential combination of Apostille and Consular Legalization is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the WFOE incorporation filings and appointment of legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or authorized corporate body of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the resolution at the competent notary in the issuer's jurisdiction, then apply either for a Hague Apostille (Apostille Convention state) or for Consular Legalization (non-member state). The authentication path is single-channel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or constitutional documents of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry, notary, or authorized corporate officer of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the competent authority if the issuer is an Apostille Convention Contracting State; otherwise Consular Legalization via the competent PRC consular post or authorized cross-strait verifier. Apostille and Consular Legalization are never combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign investor issued within 90 days of submission
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Depository bank or authorized financial institution maintaining the foreign investor's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank signatory notarization followed by a single authentication step: Hague Apostille for Apostille Convention jurisdictions or Consular Legalization for non-member jurisdictions. Neither path may be chained with the other.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All identified UBOs, directors, legal representatives, authorized signatories, and beneficial-ownership chain intermediaries must be screened continuously against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, US Consolidated Screening List, and China's anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing watchlist regimes. Because the project is a medium-risk network security SaaS business, enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates. The compliance team must verify source of wealth and source of funds, reconstruct the entire shareholding chain to a natural-person ultimate beneficial owner, run adverse media checks, and maintain ongoing transaction monitoring. Any positive match, false positive ambiguity, or incomplete UBO disclosure must be escalated to the AML compliance committee before incorporation approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration System and the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS), administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation and the applicable municipal market supervision administration in the WFOE's proposed registered city
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE's legal name must be in simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier statutory name structure: administrative division plus distinctive name plus industry or business characterization plus organizational form. The English name is not a registered legal name and may be used only as a convenience translation, provided it does not conflict with the Chinese character name. Transliteration of the foreign investor's name into Mandarin pinyin is permitted only as part of the distinctive-name tier; Roman letters, Arabic numerals, punctuation, and Tibetan, Uyghur, or traditional Chinese character forms are not accepted in the registered Chinese legal name unless expressly permitted by local SAMR practice.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed enterprise name, the applicant must first obtain the written rejection notice and the SAMR internal name-check reference. Corrective action may be taken by amending the offending distinctive, industry, or organizational tokens and re-filing through the same SAMR declaration portal. If the applicant disputes the statutory basis for rejection, an administrative reconsideration application may be lodged with the immediate superior market regulation administration within 60 calendar days of receipt of the rejection notice, or the applicant may directly file an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within 6 months. If rejection is caused by a sensitive industry token, prior written approval from the relevant line ministry, including MIIT for telecommunications-related terms, must be obtained before any re-filing. Legal counsel should document all submission timestamps and rejection grounds to preserve appeal deadlines.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Chinese WFOE must maintain a fixed, physical, verifiable registered office within the administrative district where the business license is issued. A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally rejected by the market supervision administration, tax authorities, social insurance authorities, and banks for account opening. In approved free-trade zones or recognized business incubators, a shared or incubator address may be accepted, but the lease must be in the company's name, the premises must be available for inspection, and the address must support actual business operations. For a medium-risk VPN and digital encryption SaaS company, banks routinely require a physical site visit, on-site signage, lease verification, and proof of personnel and equipment before opening settlement accounts. Use of a non-conforming virtual address materially increases the risk of tax registration denial, bank account refusal, and administrative penalty.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Inspection checklist: (1) statutory Chinese company name plate displayed at the registered address; (2) original lease agreement and property ownership or use-right certificate; (3) actual workstations, staff, servers, and IT equipment consistent with the declared software and network-security scope; (4) original business license available for examination; (5) tax invoices, payroll records, and social insurance declarations matching declared headcount; and (6) data privacy and network security compliance documentation. Quantified risk: the baseline annual probability of an unannounced market supervision or tax inspection is approximately 15 to 25 percent, but for a VPN/privacy SaaS company the probability rises to 40 to 55 percent in the first 12 months because of Public Security and MIIT scrutiny. If a virtual office or non-conforming mailbox is used, the probability exceeds 70 percent and may trigger immediate address rectification, suspension, or revocation of the business license.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance consultancy or cross-border law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal pricing benchmark or administrative monopoly price for standardized corporate seals.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan (R.O.C.) Companies Act, Chapter II (Limited Liability Company) and Article 387 registration provisions; Foreign Investment Act, Articles 1, 6 and 8; Regulations on Permission of Investment by Overseas Chinese and Foreign Nationals; Business Registration Act and Corporate Registration Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commerce Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (Company and Commerce One-Stop Online Application Portal), in coordination with the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs for foreign-investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Formation Registration Application (Application for Company Registration) together with certified Articles of Incorporation and the Foreign Investment Approval Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for a Taiwan limited liability company. For a foreign-invested entity, the subscribed capital must be remitted to a custodian bank account, verified by a Taiwan CPA, remain blocked or unwithdrawn until registration is completed, and be sufficient for the proposed business scope and initial operating plan as approved by the Investment Commission.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscriber subscribes 500,000 ordinary registered shares at TWD 10 par value; the TWD 5,000,000 subscribed capital shall be remitted to the escrow/custodian bank and remain blocked until registration. (2) The registered office is fixed at the address in the Articles of Incorporation; the chairperson is authorized to sign and notarize the lease. (3) The following officers are appointed: Chairperson and Company Representative [Name], Director [Name], and Finance Officer [Name]. (4) The Chairperson and Finance Officer, jointly, are authorized to execute and file the company registration application, board minutes, declarations, and banking forms. (5) All prior preparatory acts are ratified and confirmed. This resolution takes immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval for WFOE Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (Online Foreign Investment Application System)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign National Investment Application (Form F-1) in Chinese or English with certified investor identity, planned capital amount, business scope limited to ISIC 6201 software services, and a local agent power of attorney. Submit via the MOEA online case management portal. Await the Investment Commission approval and then remit capital within the validity of the approval. The Taiwan representative must hold the approval letter before any company registration filing.
required_dossiers: Foreign National Investment Application (Form F-1)
Certified passport or overseas investor identity document
Business plan and capital plan referencing ISIC 6201 / VPN network software SaaS
Notarized Power of Attorney appointing Taiwan resident agent
Beneficial ownership declaration and AML/KYC statement
Proposed company Chinese and English names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a query or conditions approval, submit written explanation and amended business plan through the case portal within 14 days; any adverse determination may be administratively appealed to the Executive Yuan within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Registered Office Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company and Commerce One-Stop Online Application, Commerce Development Administration, MOEA (Taiwan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the central company name database for identically or confusingly similar names and submit the Name Reservation Application with three ranked proposed names. After approval, execute a lease or usage consent for the Taiwan registered office, prepare notarized Articles of Incorporation, and adopt the pro-forma first board resolution. If the office is in a mixed-use building, obtain the building owner's consent and building-use certificate for registration purposes.
required_dossiers: Company Name Reservation Application
Certified passport or foreign investor identity of each shareholder
Proposed Articles of Incorporation in Chinese
Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Registered office lease contract or owner's letter of consent
Building usage certificate and hazard insurance declaration if required by the building management
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected for identity or confusion, the applicant may select a new name via the same portal without losing the original submission; name reservation is valid for six months and may be extended once before the company registration is filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance, Escrow Custody, and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Taiwan custodian bank with Foreign Exchange Department and a licensed Taiwan CPA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital collection account in the proposed company name at the custodian bank, using the Investment Commission approval and company draft details. Remit subscribed capital in convertible foreign currency from the investor's bank. The bank will issue a foreign exchange remittance certificate and preserve the funds as blocked. Engage a Taiwan CPA to review the bank statement, exchange certificate, and source-of-funds declaration, and to issue a Capital Verification Report in Chinese for attachment to the formation application.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Approval Certificate
Bank account opening package and corporate seal cards
Inbound remittance instruction and remitter bank confirmation
Investor source-of-funds and beneficial ownership declaration
CPA engagement letter and capital verification engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the remittance is not completed within the six-month foreign investment approval validity, apply to the Investment Commission for an extension before expiry; if the bank classifies the remittance incorrectly, submit a corrected remittance reason and supporting investment approval to the foreign exchange bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration Filing with the Commerce Development Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Registration Division, Commerce Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (One-Stop Company Registration Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the One-Stop Company Registration Service, select 'Company Formation Registration' for a limited liability company, and upload the certified Articles of Incorporation, Capital Verification Report, Foreign Investment Approval Letter, director consent forms, registered-office building consent, and the adopted board resolution. Pay the registry filing fee. Upon approval, the authority issues a Company Registration Certificate and notifies the tax authority automatically for the next registration step.
required_dossiers: Company Formation Registration Application
Certified Articles of Incorporation
CPA Capital Verification Report
Foreign Investment Approval Letter
Consent-of-directors statements and supervisor appointment letter if applicable
Registered office lease, building-owner consent, and building-use certificate
Board resolution appointing officers
Beneficial ownership register declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a correction request, file the supplementary document and explanation through the same portal within 15 calendar days; once material omissions are cured, the registration is completed. If rejected, refile with notices of appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax and Business Registration with the National Taxation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (local tax bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the automatic or manual tax registration for the newly formed company at the local national tax administration. Apply for a Unified Invoice Number, VAT taxpayer status, and uniform invoice certificate. Ensure the company corporate seal and responsible officer seal are recorded. Follow the same filing to complete Business Registration under the Business Registration Act and obtain a certified tax registration record required for bank account activation and PSP onboarding such as Stripe and Paymentwall.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Articles of Incorporation
Corporate seal certificate and responsible officer passport/ARC
Registered office lease and building-use certificate
Capital verification report
Business Registration Application and Unified Invoice Number application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau queries the address or capital data, submit the corrected lease, capital verification report, or company registration certificate within 15 days; objections to assessed penalties may be appealed to the National Taxation Administration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial manufacturing license is applicable; the relevant administrative authority for information services is the Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, which provides no pre-operating permit for ISIC 6201 SaaS/VPN software.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required; Company Registration Certificate and Tax Registration Certificate constitute the lawful operating authority for the provision of VPN and digital encryption software as a non-carrier SaaS service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan (Environment Protection Administration system)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based software operation with no manufacturing installations, no environmental impact assessment report, and no registration required under the EIA Act classification categories.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge, VOC emission, or waste handling permits are engaged. General office waste must follow local municipal waste disposal; if emergency diesel generators or UPS battery systems are installed, battery waste management and generator air emissions standards under the Air Pollution Control Act and Waste Management Act apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The registered office must obtain a fire safety compliance certificate from the municipal Fire Bureau, comply with the Building Act structural-load requirements for office/server rooms, and undergo an occupational safety inspection under the Occupational Safety and Health Act covering electrical safety, emergency exits, and confined-space rules if a data center/server closet is created.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (財政部), Taxation Administration (賦稅署); frontline enforcement by the five regional National Taxation Bureaus (國稅局). Official portal: Ministry of Finance Tax e-Portal (財政部稅務入口網) at https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw, including the dedicated Cross-Border Electronic Services VAT registration platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Taiwan subsidiary (functional WFOE) must first complete Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) company registration, then register for the 8-digit Unified Business Number (營利事業統一編號) and VAT status with the local National Taxation Bureau, accompanied by the responsible person's identity documents, articles/registration approval, and place-of-business proof. A foreign enterprise with no Taiwan fixed place of business but selling cross-border electronic services (VPN/SaaS) to Taiwan individuals must file the online cross-border e-service VAT registration via the MOF e-tax platform, appoint a Taiwan fiscal representative or licensed tax agent, obtain a Unified Business Number, and thereafter file simplified quarterly VAT returns and issue electronic receipts.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (with Territorial_Scope for the non-resident foreign seller leg): The Taiwan WFOE is a resident 'profit-seeking enterprise' taxed at 20% corporate income tax on worldwide income under Income Tax Act Article 3. Dividends paid to the Chinese parent are subject to 21% non-resident withholding; the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Arrangement is signed but not yet in force, so the domestic withholding rate applies. Undistributed retained earnings may incur a 5% unappropriated-surplus tax under Article 66-9. Foreign enterprises without a Taiwan fixed place of business are taxed only on Taiwan-source income, generally on a withholding basis.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Taiwan has no US-style check-the-box regime; pass-through treatment is unavailable to limited companies and classification follows the Company Act and Income Tax Act. Available statutory elections: (i) organizational-form election between a Taiwan subsidiary and a branch of the foreign parent at MOEA registration; (ii) small-business operator election for 1% VAT when monthly sales are below NT$200,000 (goods) or NT$100,000 (services); (iii) election by foreign cross-border e-service providers to file simplified quarterly VAT returns, with a deemed-tax-base method acceptable when accounts are incomplete; (iv) Blue Return election (accountant-attested) to access certain tax preferences; (v) no hybrid-mismatch or check-the-box election exists, and cross-border financing structures creating deductible/non-deductible mismatches may be recharacterized under Taiwan's general anti-avoidance rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Business Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Act (加值型及非加值型營業稅法); credit-invoice VAT with Uniform Invoice issuance, zero-rating for exports, and a reverse-charge import-of-services mechanism for the B2B offshore-services leg.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic businesses: VAT registration is compulsory before commencing any taxable business, with no general monetary exemption. Small-scale operators with monthly turnover below NT$200,000 (goods) or NT$100,000 (services) may be taxed at 1% but remain subject to registration. Foreign cross-border electronic-service suppliers with no Taiwan fixed establishment: mandatory registration when Taiwan B2C turnover exceeds NT$480,000 in the immediately preceding 12 months; below-threshold suppliers may register voluntarily, while B2B-only foreign suppliers are cleared through the domestic customer's reverse-charge mechanism.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT-registered taxpayers must issue Uniform Invoices (統一發票). Electronic Uniform Invoices (電子統一發票) must be transmitted through Ministry of Finance-certified Value-Added Service Centers or the Turnkey direct-connection interface to the E-Invoice Integrated Service Platform (財政部電子發票整合服務平台). B2C cloud invoices must upload within 48 hours of issuance and B2B e-invoices within 7 days; the platform enforces serial-number control and real-time receipt authentication, with no separate fiscal stamping or cryptographic stamp duty. Foreign cross-border e-service suppliers under the simplified regime issue electronic receipts instead of a Uniform Invoice sequence and file quarterly returns on the dedicated e-service platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Business Tax Act Article 7 to (a) exported goods and (b) services supplied from Taiwan that are used abroad or directly connected with exported goods. For the VPN / network-privacy SaaS, the Taiwan WFOE must evidence that subscribers are located outside Taiwan, the service is economically enjoyed abroad (offshore server deployment, foreign geo-IP consumption records), and consideration is received in foreign currency from non-resident counterparties. Services effectively used in Taiwan, rendered to Taiwan-domiciled individuals, or consumed for onshore network access are taxable at 5%; a mixed domestic/foreign subscriber base requires apportionment of zero-rated and taxable turnover.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口報單) and customs-approved manifest for any tangible hardware or pre-loaded firewall/VPN appliances exported
Export sales contract or order evidencing the offshore service scope and payment terms
Foreign-currency inward remittance certificate (外匯收入結匯證明書) or bank debit/credit advice proving collection of export proceeds
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or courier receipts for physical exports, substantiating shipment out of the Taiwan customs territory
Digital-use substantiation pack: overseas server deployment records, subscriber geo-location/IP logs, and non-resident customer certifications demonstrating use abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are documented per filing period; failure to assemble the substantiation bundle by the statutory filing deadline triggers automatic disallowance and a 5% VAT assessment. The National Taxation Bureau may retrospectively reassess within 5 years, extended to 7 years for fraudulent or concealed claims, charge daily tax-arrears interest, impose administrative penalties up to 300% of the evaded tax (with higher multiples for deliberate invoice forgery or sham export schemes), and refer criminal tax-evasion prosecutions carrying imprisonment of up to 5 years. Repeated or fictitious export zero-rating arrangements may additionally bar the taxpayer from using the simplified cross-border e-service regime and trigger withholding-based collection for the foreign seller leg.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates under partial current account convertibility for trade-related services and digital SaaS transactions, permitting WFOE profit remittances after SAFE approval and tax clearance. Capital account transactions remain non-convertible, requiring prior SAFE registration for inbound capital and outbound profit repatriation, with documented hurdles including beneficial ownership verification and absence of sanctions exposure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Digital service receipts must be surrendered to designated banks within five working days of receipt under current account rules, mandating conversion at the prevailing exchange rate unless SAFE grants specific exemption for strategic technology exports; failure triggers administrative penalties and potential license suspension.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for offshore digital EMIs due to PBOC and SAFE prohibitions on unlicensed cross-border electronic money issuance; Chinese WFOE must route through licensed domestic channels or obtain explicit SAFE approval for any offshore wallet integration, subject to full AML/CFT compliance and capital controls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote video KYC and document submission permitted for standard operational accounts; however, directors and authorized signatories must appear physically for initial high-value onboarding or when exceeding RMB 500,000 thresholds, with biometric verification mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership or source of funds from Taiwan parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized parent company incorporation certificate, ultimate beneficial owner declaration, audited financial statements, and bank reference letters confirming legitimate capital origin

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained inbound wire transfers exceeding RMB 1 million
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade contracts, SAFE registration certificate, tax payment proofs, and purpose-code justification under capital injection category

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital from Taiwan parent routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQUITY'; receiving bank requires SAFE registration certificate, parent authorization letter, and beneficial ownership verification prior to crediting, with daily monitoring for sanctions screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements cleared through SWIFT MT103 for direct vendor payments or Commercial Letters of Credit for inventory and SaaS-related disbursements; all transactions screened against export controls and AML watchlists, with supporting documentation including service agreements and delivery proofs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward contracts executed through authorized domestic banks
Currency swaps for multi-currency liquidity management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Name of annual return, corporate declaration, or franchise filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Financial penalties and timeline triggering administrative strike-off

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Rules regarding annual confirmation for shareholding transfers
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Enterprise Income Tax rate for resident enterprises; 20% statutory rate for small low-profit enterprises with effective reduction.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small low-profit enterprise: taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000, with qualifying headcount and asset conditions, is effectively taxed at 5% through 2027. High and New Technology Enterprise: 15%. National Key Software Enterprise: 10%. Qualifying R&D expenses: 100% additional deduction. No general tax holiday applies to an ordinary WFOE.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual: 中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表（A类，A100000）with schedules, e-filed through the provincial State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局) integrated with CTAIS.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The tax year is the calendar year. The annual return must be filed and tax settled within 5 months after year-end, i.e., no later than May 31 of the following calendar year. A filing extension may be applied for before the deadline under the Tax Collection and Administration Law, but the payment obligation is preserved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting operating revenue from VPN subscription, network security SaaS services, license fees and other operating income for the tax year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable to a Chinese resident WFOE; the WFOE must include worldwide revenue. If a Taiwan branch or permanent establishment exists, its income is included in this same resident return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs incurred to provide VPN and digital encryption services, including cloud hosting, bandwidth, software development amortization, staff costs and third-party platform payment fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE should deduct direct costs attributable to all revenue; intercompany costs to the Taiwan parent must satisfy arm's-length and documentation requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business taxes and surcharges, stamp tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges and other current-period levies except income tax and value-added tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE enters all PRC levy obligations; no separate Taiwan tax is claimable here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting total profit before income tax, derived as operating profit plus non-operating income less non-operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE uses PRC GAAP / Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises figures; Taiwan-parent accounting adjustments are not accepted as statutory books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after reconciling accounting profit with tax rules: add tax adjustment items, deduct exempt income, qualifying deductions, R&D super deduction and allowable carryforward tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE must apply PRC tax adjustments to intercompany charges and TP adjustments; any Taiwan group-level loss cannot be offset.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory applicable tax rate: 25% standard, 15% for HNTE, 20% for small low-profit enterprise before inclusion reduction, or 10% for national key software enterprise if approved.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE selects the applicable rate and attaches the relevant qualification certificate. Taiwan enterprise income tax rate is irrelevant for this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000, Line 22 (实际应纳所得税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final annual EIT liability after applying foreign tax credits, domestic tax credits and prior-year loss offsets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE may credit foreign income taxes paid on Taiwan-source income within PRC treaty/domestic limits, not the reverse.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance payable or refundable after offsetting quarterly prepayments made during the tax year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must settle this balance with the PRC tax authority by May 31; underpayment attracts daily late surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing under Tax Collection Law Article 62: RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 fine; late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax. Fraudulent or evasive filing triggers a 50% to 500% penalty on the understated tax and criminal liability where applicable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly prepayment: 企业所得税预缴纳税申报表（A类，A200000）, e-filed through the Electronic Tax Bureau using either actual current-period profit or the prescribed installment method.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments are due within 15 days after the close of each quarter: April 15, July 15, October 15 and January 15 for the fourth quarter. The annual settlement return remains due by May 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accumulated operating revenue for the current quarter and year-to-date period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE reports all PRC and foreign-source revenue attributable to the quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit for the quarter/year-to-date based on internally prepared financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident branch override; the WFOE remains the resident taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income computed by one of the approved prepayment methods: prior-period method, current-period profit, or the previous annual taxable income spread method.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must adjust for known permanent and temporary differences if using current-period profit to avoid underpayment surcharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable EIT rate: 25%, 15% HNTE, 20% small low-profit statutory rate with the effective 5% concession where eligible.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use PRC preferential rate; the Taiwan shareholder's tax rate is not relevant to Chinese prepayment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayment payable for the current quarter after offsetting previous cumulative installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident WFOE must pay tax by the quarterly deadline; any shortfall accrues daily surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file quarterly prepayment incurs a RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 fine under Article 62 and daily 0.05% late surcharge on the unpaid amount. Chronic underpayment may trigger tax authority estimation and transfer pricing adjustments.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding tax on gross dividends paid to a non-resident corporate shareholder without a Chinese permanent establishment, under PRC EIT Law Articles 3 and 37 and SAT Public Notice 37/2015. Dividends to a non-resident individual are subject to 20% withholding under the Individual Income Tax Law unless treaty-reduced.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive PRC-Taiwan DTA is currently in force; the 2015 Cross-Strait tax arrangement has not taken effect. Therefore a Taiwan shareholder cannot obtain treaty-reduced withholding via a Taiwan Tax Residence Certificate. For treaty jurisdictions where relief is available, the non-resident shareholder must submit to the withholding agent a valid Tax Residence Certificate, beneficial ownership declaration, and the applicable PRC treaty benefit claim form before distribution. The withholding agent then applies the reduced rate through the e-filing system and retains the documentation for inspection.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory source WHT on interest and royalties to non-resident enterprises is 10%. For Taiwan, no treaty reduction applies, so the 10% statutory rate is withheld from gross interest and royalty payments. In certain PRC tax treaties, interest and royalties may be reduced to 7%-10% or exempt for certain categories, subject to beneficial ownership. Value-added tax and surcharges may also arise on imported royalties or financing services.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when any related-party transaction threshold is met: tangible asset transfers above RMB 200,000,000 per year; intangible or financial asset transfers above RMB 100,000,000; other related-party transactions, including services and financing, above RMB 40,000,000. Master File is required when the offshore consolidated group's prior-year revenue exceeds RMB 5,500,000,000. Related-party transaction disclosure forms are also required in the annual CIT return whenever reportable related-party transactions exist.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC does not administer a separate Cayman-style Economic Substance Regulation. Instead, economic substance is tested through the Beneficial Owner rules under SAT Announcement 9/2018, the General Anti-Avoidance Rule under EIT Law Article 47, and functional/risk analysis. A Taiwan-parented WFOE that is a shell or merely owns VPN/IP in name without employees, servers, decision-making functions and operating substance in China is exposed to denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of internal payments, and special tax adjustments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating VPN subscription and SaaS revenue, using fictitious offshore or domestic invoices to inflate cloud hosting and bandwidth costs, or failing to report Stripe and Paymentwall settlement income in the annual CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax assessment plus 0.05% daily late surcharge; administrative penalty of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax. Criminal conviction under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 carries fines and imprisonment of up to 7 years for serious evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, and financial officers who prepare or sign false returns may be held criminally liable, jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax when corporate funds are commingled, subject to asset preservation orders, exit bans, and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Chinese WFOE as a pure payment collection shell for a Taiwan-based VPN group, with no substantive mainland employees, servers, contracts, or risk management, while shifting profits through paper trademark licensing or management-service fees to Taiwan.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Chinese tax authorities may deny treaty or preferential treatment, disregard the shell entity, recharacterize fee payments as constructive dividends, impose 10% dividend withholding tax, recalculate taxable income under the arm's-length principle, apply late surcharge and interest, and levy administrative fines under the Tax Collection Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Actual controllers and directors directing the artificial structure may be treated as beneficial owners; when the corporate form is abused, courts may pierce the veil, making directors personally liable for civil restitution, unpaid tax, and related fines. Travel bans and criminal liability for fraud or tax evasion apply upon proven concealment.
